newsitem.title: UK: OPEC to market monthly oil supply-demand report.
newsitem.headline: OPEC to market monthly oil supply-demand report.

text.p: The OPEC Secretariat plans to sell its monthly oil market report which includes forecasts for global oil supply and demand, an OPEC official said on Wednesday.

The official at OPEC's Vienna Secretariat said the report will include production and market supply figures provided to OPEC by the 11 OPEC members themselves as well as data on non-OPEC supply, world oil demand and oil inventories compiled by energy experts from OPEC countries based at the Secretariat.
"The report will also include the views of OPEC on certain issues," the official said.
The official said OPEC, at a meeting last week of its Economic Commission Board (ECB), decided to change some of the ways it compiled the monthly report.

He said the new report would be similar in content to the monthly oil market report compiled by the International Energy Agency (IEA) which represents the world's largest oil-consuming nations of the OECD.

Those interested in receiving a free three-month trial subscription to OPEC's oil market report should contact the OPEC information department in Vienna on telephone (431) 211 120 or by fax on (431) 216 4320.
